standard_prerequisites.name: Schwartz-Zippel, standard low-degree extensions and constrained-polynomial sampling algorithm cited by authors
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Full original author bibliography retained; source-local lower-bound and simulation proofs included.

core_obligations: Verify the multi-round sumcheck protocol with algebraic decommitments and obtain its complexity bounds.
Sample constrained polynomial partial sums in the simulator and prove streaming indistinguishability.
difficulty_reason: Extends the algebraic commitment machinery to a multi-round sumcheck protocol while preserving streaming access and constructs a constrained-polynomial simulator. The complete protocol, correctness proof and reduction establishing zero-knowledge are retained together as one principal result.

dedup.scope: Root checked the complete legacy, aliases, preparation and both active lines for the exclusively allocated DOI with zero neighbors. These three records count distinct algebraic commitment, polynomial-evaluation zero-knowledge, and sumcheck zero-knowledge principal protocols. Correctness/security halves, application corollaries and source-local supporting lemmas are uncounted.
